entry.title: Awesome Capacitor Updates on Jan 08, 2026

  • Live Reload (⭐9) - Reload Capacitor apps from a remote Vite dev server.

Capgo plugins / Device & Sensors

  • Accelerometer (⭐8) - Read device accelerometer measurements.
  • Barometer (⭐7) - Access device barometer readings.
  • Brightness (⭐5) - Control screen brightness on iOS and Android.
  • Compass (⭐6) - Native compass heading plugin.
  • Light Sensor (⭐5) - Access the device light sensor (Android only).
  • Mute (⭐14) - Detect if the mute switch is enabled/disabled on a device.
  • Pedometer (⭐11) - Access pedometer data including steps, distance, pace, cadence, and floors.
  • Shake (⭐19) - Detect shake gesture in device.
  • Volume Buttons (⭐7) - Listen to volume button presses.
  • SIM (⭐10) - Get information from device's sim cards.

Capgo plugins / Camera & Media

  • Camera Preview (⭐47) - Native camera preview with custom controls.
  • Document Scanner (⭐22) - Scan documents on iOS and Android.
  • Audio Recorder (⭐13) - Record audio on iOS, Android, and Web.
  • Native Audio (⭐74) - A native plugin for native audio engine.
  • Audio Session (⭐8) - Get notified about audio interrupts & route changes on iOS.
  • Screen Recorder (⭐26) - Record device's screen.
  • Video Player (⭐12) - Play video in native player.
  • Video Thumbnails (⭐5) - Generate video thumbnails from local or remote video files.
  • Photo Library (⭐10) - Display photo gallery as web page or native screen.
  • FFmpeg (⭐9) - Exposes the FFmpeg API to Capacitor.
  • IVS Player (⭐10) - Amazon IVS player for Capacitor apps.
  • JW Player (⭐9) - Play videos from jwplayer.com.
  • Mux Player (⭐9) - Native Mux Player SDK to play video on iOS and Android.
  • YouTube Player (⭐9) - Embed YouTube player controls in Capacitor apps.
  • Media Session (⭐8) - Expose media session controls of the device.

Capgo plugins / Storage & Files

  • Data Storage SQLite (⭐103) - SQLite Storage of key/value strings pair.
  • Fast SQL (⭐18) - High-performance native SQLite plugin with custom protocol for efficient sync operations.
  • File (⭐5) - System operations compatible with Cordova File plugin API.
  • File Picker (⭐6) - Pick files, images, videos, and directories.
  • File Compressor (⭐7) - Efficient image compression supporting PNG, JPEG, and WebP formats.

  • Native Geocoder (⭐41) - Native forward and reverse geocoding.

Capgo plugins / Authentication & Security

  • Native Biometric (⭐77) - Access native biometric APIs for Android and iOS.
  • Social Login (⭐213) - All social logins in one plugin.
  • Autofill Save Password (⭐16) - Prompt to save login into device password manager.
  • Persistent Account (⭐10) - Securely store account information for a user.
  • Is Root (⭐12) - Jailbreak/Root Detection Plugin.

Capgo plugins / UI & Display

  • In App Browser (⭐128) - Native in-app browser for secure web content.
  • Navigation Bar (⭐25) - Set navigation bar color for Android Lollipop and higher.
  • Home Indicator (⭐9) - Hide and show home button indicator in Capacitor app.
  • Screen Orientation (⭐6) - Control device orientation with support for bypassing orientation lock.
  • Flash (⭐23) - Switch the Flashlight / Torch of your device.
  • Keep Awake (⭐6) - Prevent the device screen from dimming or sleeping.

Capgo plugins / Purchases & Payments

  • Native Purchases (⭐45) - In-app Subscriptions Made Easy.

  • Crisp - Native SDK for customer messaging and chat support.

  • iBeacon (⭐11) - Proximity detection and beacon region monitoring.
  • Speech Recognition (⭐17) - Comprehensive on-device speech recognition with live partial results.

  • In App Review (⭐6) - Prompt users to submit app store ratings and reviews without leaving your app.

  • Android Age Signals (⭐8) - Exposes Google Play Age Signals to your app.

Capgo plugins / Platform Integrations

  • Supabase - Native Supabase SDK integration - Auth, Database, and JWT access.
  • WeChat (⭐14) - SDK for authentication, sharing, payments, and mini-programs.
  • Watch - Apple Watch communication with bidirectional messaging support.
  • Share Target (⭐19) - Receive shared content from other apps.

Capgo plugins / Firebase

  • Analytics (⭐6) - Firebase Analytics for Capacitor.
  • App (⭐6) - Firebase App for Capacitor.
  • Authentication (⭐6) - Firebase Authentication for Capacitor.
  • Crashlytics (⭐6) - Firebase Crashlytics for Capacitor.
  • Firestore (⭐6) - Firebase Cloud Firestore for Capacitor.
  • Functions (⭐6) - Firebase Cloud Functions for Capacitor.
  • Messaging (⭐6) - Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for Capacitor.
  • Performance (⭐6) - Firebase Performance Monitoring for Capacitor.
  • Remote Config (⭐6) - Firebase Remote Config for Capacitor.
  • Storage (⭐6) - Firebase Cloud Storage for Capacitor.

Capgo plugins / Utilities

  • Alarm (⭐12) - Manage native alarms.
  • Env (⭐8) - Set Env var in Capacitor config and read them at runtime.
  • WebView Guardian (⭐8) - Detect when the WebView was killed in the background and relaunch it on foreground.
  • LLM (⭐40) - Adds support for LLM locally run for Capacitor.

Capgo plugins / Specialized Hardware

  • Ricoh360 Camera (⭐7) - SDK for the Ricoh360 cameras.
